id: title:Gilbert09:classify http 400 from the report endpoint as non retryable

review.posthog_relevance: This change improves the reliability of the Rokt Ads warehouse connector by correctly classifying HTTP 400 responses as permanent failures, preventing unnecessary retry loops for account or configuration errors.
review.reason: Adds a 400 Client Error entry to the non-retryable error dictionary, including a descriptive message and a test assertion.
review.uncertainty: While the code change is substantive and bounded, the actual benefit depends on the frequency and nature of 400 errors encountered in production, which is not demonstrated by this patch. No adoption or incident avoidance is inferred.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are cited. No score assigned.
